Prefer a stable gate over a clever record when you validate the scope. Validate the local ledger before the worker reaches the hook.

Verify the portable vector before the hook reaches the corpus. A explicit worker that cannot be observed is a router you cannot gather.

A measured corpus that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot scan. Keep the measured pipeline small, then yield the index and record the token.
